free wifi

 Welcome to this charming, sun-soaked 2 bedrooms apartment located on the 1st floor of the renowned Diana Building, offering stunning panoramic sea views. Whether you’re lounging on the terrace or waking up to the serene coastal beauty, this holiday home is your perfect Marbella retreat.

 Nestled above the picturesque Paseo Marítimo, the iconic maritime promenade, the Diana Building boasts an unbeatable location right in the heart of Marbella. This vibrant complex features lush communal gardens, a refreshing swimming pool, and convenient resident parking (subject to availability). Plus, you’ll be surrounded by a variety of local bars, restaurants, and shops, with the iconic Old Town and Orange Square just a 10-minute walk away.

 During your stay, you can enjoy the convenience of lift access, and a well-appointed studio with a queen bed and twin bed, both offering direct access to the private terrace with breathtaking sea views. You’ll have everything you need for a comfortable stay, including a flat-screen TV for entertainment, and a separate, fully-equipped kitchen featuring an electric oven, fridge/freezer, kettle, and coffee maker. The apartment also includes a separate bathroom with a stylish shower for your relaxation and convenience.

 Whether you’re here to relax by the pool, explore the charming streets of Marbella, or simply enjoy the views from your terrace, this property promises a memorable holiday experience.

 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 Private A/C.

 The pool is open from the 15th of June to the 15th of September, both inclusive. The pool hours are from 12 pm until 8 pm.

 Check-in (from 4pm): the keys will be in a key box in our office; we will provide you with the information prior to your arrival. It is important that you tell us your estimated arrival time at least 48 hours before.

 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest are included in the rental price.

 Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella!
